params.name: pageSize
params.description: The number of items to return in one response. The minimum is 1 and the maximum is 1000.

params.name: pageNumber
params.description: The page number of the set of items to return. The default is 1.

params.name: filter
params.description: An expression that lets you specify a subset of items to return. Use the format filter=field:operator:value. Operators include eq, gt, gte, lt, lte, has, and in.

params.name: sort
params.description: An expression that lets you specify the order in which items are returned. Use the format sort=field:direction where direction is asc or desc.
